## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes, and new behaviour has a test
- [ ] The UI loads without console errors (if the UI changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` updated if behaviour, schema, routes, MCP tools, config or security changed
- [ ] No tokens, secret URLs or personal data in code, tests or screenshots
